verdict.rationale: Conductor's core function is running AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) against your own codebase inside the app. The agents can test repos, run builds, and propose diffs for review, so AI-generated suggestions on your code are delivered through agent chats and review paths. However, there is no dedicated insights feature; suggestions come only from the third-party agents it orchestrates, not from a first-party analysis layer. Missing for 10: a native insights/suggestions feature over user data, proactive or summarized recommendations, and independent hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
